  | List.cons item rest => (((project item index) =? position) && (match{
    branches: [
      {body: false, binders: [], constructor: List.nil},
      {body: true, binders: [first, others], constructor: List.cons}
    ],
    scrutinee: (project item evidence)
  } && (obligationsEvidenced (position + 1) rest))))

modeledAssetVolunteerGatewayAndArchiveBundle means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledAsset {asset := "Security::assetVolunteerGatewayAndArchiveBundle", name := "Volunteer Stitch Gateway and Public Archive Bundle", text := "Self-contained public-benefit Stitch bundle served by verdant gateway serve, static OCI containers, IPFS content-addressed roots, Zenodo DOI archives, and offline portable HTML envelopes with zero commercial PaaS registrations."})
modeledThreatSignalingRelayEclipseOrMitm means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatSignalingRelayEclipseOrMitm", name := "Signaling relay eclipse or Sybil peer spoofing", text := "A malicious public text relay or Sybil peer spoofs Stitch Layer-5 stitch/1 announcements or eclipses a visitor from honest WebRTC seeders.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.spoofing)})
modeledThreatVolunteerGatewayContentSubstitution means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatVolunteerGatewayContentSubstitution", name := "Volunteer gateway content substitution or shard tampering", text := "A compromised volunteer HTTP gateway, OCI container, or IPFS mirror serves altered Blank Frame assets, modified frame-pin.json pointers, or corrupted STCH2 shards.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.tampering)})
modeledThreatUnverifiableGatewayProvenance means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatUnverifiableGatewayProvenance", name := "Unverifiable gateway release provenance", text := "A volunteer mirror or peer serves an unofficial or stale release bundle whose origin, release epoch, and quorum lineage cannot be verified or audited.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.repudiation)})
modeledThreatSignalingIpOrPresenceCorrelation means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatSignalingIpOrPresenceCorrelation", name := "Signaling IP or private workspace presence correlation", text := "Unscoped public text-relay signaling topics or unconsented WebRTC ICE exchanges expose a visitor's network IP address, presence graph, or private workspace identifiers.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.informationDisclosure)})
modeledThreatSignalingTopicSpamOrWebRtcAmplification means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatSignalingTopicSpamOrWebRtcAmplification", name := "Signaling topic spam or WebRTC seeder amplification", text := "An unauthenticated attacker floods public Stitch Layer-5 signaling topics with oversized frames or triggers WebRTC DataChannel amplification to exhaust volunteer browser or node bandwidth.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.denialOfService)})
modeledThreatMaliciousGatewayPathTraversalOrOriginAbuse means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledThreat {threat := "Security::threatMaliciousGatewayPathTraversalOrOriginAbuse", name := "Gateway path traversal or cross-origin privilege abuse", text := "A crafted HTTP request exploits path traversal on a volunteer Stitch gateway or a hostile mirror abuses cross-origin headers to access host files or cross-origin Prism ID state.", category := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::Stride.elevationOfPrivilege)})

modeledControlBlankFrameZeroTrustHashAndPinLock means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledControl {control := "Security::controlBlankFrameZeroTrustHashAndPinLock", name := "Zero-trust Blank Frame SHA-256 and monotonic epoch pin lock", text := "Treats every volunteer gateway, IPFS mirror, and peer as untrusted transport, requiring the Blank Frame to verify quorum signatures, monotonic release epochs, and bit-exact .holo SHA-256 kappa before ServiceWorker mount.", evidence := (cons (record Production.ThreatModel::Evidence {kind := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::EvidenceKind.proof), reference := "StitchHosting::publicBenefitAvailabilityVerified"}) (nil Production.ThreatModel::Evidence))})
modeledControlSignedGatewayManifestAndEpochLineage means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledControl {control := "Security::controlSignedGatewayManifestAndEpochLineage", name := "Cryptographically committed gateway-manifest and prevKappa lineage", text := "Commits releaseVersion, releaseEpoch, releaseKappaHex, manifestKappaHex, and monotonic prevKappaHex lineage inside gateway-manifest.json and frame-pin.json across every public-benefit carrier.", evidence := (cons (record Production.ThreatModel::Evidence {kind := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::EvidenceKind.gate), reference := "cargo test -p repo-conformance engine_ve_77"}) (nil Production.ThreatModel::Evidence))})
modeledControlOptInSwarmAndOpaqueTopicIsolation means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledControl {control := "Security::controlOptInSwarmAndOpaqueTopicIsolation", name := "Opt-in capability-gated WebRTC seeding and opaque release topics", text := "Requires explicit visitor capability consent before opening WebRTC peer connections, scopes public signaling strictly to opaque release-kappa topics, and keeps all private user workspaces end-to-end encrypted.", evidence := (cons (record Production.ThreatModel::Evidence {kind := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::EvidenceKind.proof), reference := "StitchHosting::selfHostingPrinciplesComplete"}) (nil Production.ThreatModel::Evidence))})
modeledControlStitchLayer5FramingAndBudgetCeiling means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledControl {control := "Security::controlStitchLayer5FramingAndBudgetCeiling", name := "Stitch Layer-5 4096-byte wire cap and ResourceAdmission seeder ceilings", text := "Enforces stitch/1 4096-byte wire, 2700-byte chunk, 512 KiB message, 256-frame, and 60-second signal TTL bounds alongside ResourceAdmission request, transfer, storage, and compute ceilings.", evidence := (cons (record Production.ThreatModel::Evidence {kind := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::EvidenceKind.proof), reference := "StitchHosting::stitchLayer5BoundsVerified"}) (nil Production.ThreatModel::Evidence))})
modeledControlGatewayPathCanonicalizationAndOriginIsolation means(record Production.ThreatModel::ModeledControl {control := "Security::controlGatewayPathCanonicalizationAndOriginIsolation", name := "Gateway path canonicalization, read-only CORS, and origin-scoped Prism IDs", text := "Refuses dot-dot and backslash path traversal with HTTP 400, restricts volunteer gateways to read-only GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS methods inside a canonical bundle root, and isolates Prism IDs per origin.", evidence := (cons (record Production.ThreatModel::Evidence {kind := (ctor Production.ThreatModel::EvidenceKind.gate), reference := "cargo test -p repo-conformance engine_ve_78"}) (nil Production.ThreatModel::Evidence))})
